fleet.name: Rex Fleet
fleet.text: Mature post-Shattering Fleet personnel and ships use blue, white, and restrained gold as the authority/stewardship visual grammar. Operational spaces remain practical. Do not default every Fleet scene to banners, ceremony, or political grandeur.

stormwell-service.name: Stormwell Archive Service
stormwell-service.text: Fleet archival-science personnel specializing in provenance, data recovery, metrology, reconstruction, record genealogy, evidence preservation, and neutral certification. Their authority comes from method and documented uncertainty, not possession of a sacred master archive.

civil-survey.name: Civil Survey Service
civil-survey.text: Civilian corridor cartographers and field surveyors who collect raw measurements, publish navigational products, and maintain regional maps. Their equipment is rugged, distributed, and not always standardized across generations.
